short_description.id: Mothman adalah kriptid humanoid dalam cerita rakyat Amerika yang konon terlihat di sekitar Point Pleasant, West Virginia, pada 1966 hingga 1967. Meski bernama "ngengat", laporan awalnya menggambarkan ciri burung.
short_description.en: Mothman is a humanoid cryptid of American folklore reportedly seen around Point Pleasant, West Virginia, in 1966 and 1967. Despite the name, the first reports described bird-like rather than moth-like features.

long_description.id: Mothman adalah nama untuk kriptid humanoid yang konon terlihat di sekitar Point Pleasant, West Virginia, dari 15 November 1966 hingga 15 Desember 1967. Laporan surat kabar pertama terbit pada 16 November 1966, dan pers nasional segera mengangkatnya sehingga kisah ini menyebar ke seluruh Amerika Serikat. Meski bernama Mothman, laporan awal menggambarkan ciri burung, bukan ngengat.
long_description.en: Mothman is the name for a humanoid cryptid reportedly seen around Point Pleasant, West Virginia, between November 15, 1966 and December 15, 1967. The first newspaper report appeared on November 16, 1966, and the national press soon took it up, spreading the story across the United States. Despite its name, the earliest reports described features of a bird, not a moth.

long_description.id: Pada 15 November 1966 dua pasangan muda mengaku melihat makhluk hitam besar bermata menyala merah di dekat "area TNT", bekas pabrik amunisi. Linda Scarberry menggambarkannya sebagai lelaki langsing berotot setinggi sekitar tujuh kaki dengan sayap putih. Para saksi melaporkan bahwa makhluk itu terbang dan mengimbangi mobil mereka. Laporan lain menyebut sosok bersayap besar bermata merah menyala yang terpusat di sekitar Point Pleasant. Burung hantu barred memiliki pantulan cahaya mata merah tua yang mencolok, yang menurut satu sumber mungkin menjelaskan mata merah itu.
long_description.en: On November 15, 1966 two young couples said they saw a large black creature with glowing red eyes near the "TNT area", the site of an old munitions plant. In Linda Scarberry's account the figure was a lean, muscular man roughly seven feet tall, with white wings. The witnesses reported that it took flight and kept pace with their car. Other accounts speak of a large winged figure with glowing red eyes centred on the Point Pleasant area. One source notes that barred owls have a vivid crimson eyeshine, which may explain the red eyes.

long_description.id: Setelah Silver Bridge runtuh pada 15 Desember 1967 dan 46 orang tewas, muncul legenda yang menghubungkan penampakan itu dengan runtuhnya jembatan, dan penampakan menurun sesudahnya. John Keel mempopulerkan kaitan itu dalam bukunya tahun 1975. Dalam satu teori populer, kedatangan Mothman dan bencana itu dikaitkan dengan kutukan berusia 200 tahun yang dikaitkan dengan Kepala Suku Cornstalk. Peneliti Brunvand menemukan unsur yang sama antara laporan Mothman dan dongeng yang jauh lebih tua.
long_description.en: After the Silver Bridge collapsed on December 15, 1967 and 46 people died, a legend arose tying the sightings to the collapse, and sightings diminished afterward. John Keel popularized the link in his 1975 book. In one popular theory, the Mothman's arrival and the disaster were tied to a 200-year-old curse attributed to Chief Cornstalk. The researcher Brunvand found elements shared between Mothman reports and much older folktales.

long_description.id: Penjelasan lain beragam: sebagian mengusulkan bangau sandhill atau burung hantu barred, sementara hipotesis yang lebih spekulatif menyebut alien, wujud supranatural, atau spesies hewan tak dikenal. Kini legenda ini menjadi sumber utama pariwisata Point Pleasant, dengan festival tahunan dan patung. Sosok mirip Mothman juga dilaporkan terlihat berkali-kali di kawasan Chicago sejak 2011.
long_description.en: Explanations vary: some propose sandhill cranes or barred owls, while more speculative hypotheses suggest an alien, a supernatural manifestation or an unknown animal species. Today the legend is a major source of tourism for Point Pleasant, with an annual festival and a statue. A Mothman-like figure has also been reported many times around Chicago since 2011.

cultural_context.en: Tourism in Point Pleasant leans heavily on the Mothman legend, which brought the town an annual festival, a statue and a museum.

claims.quote: On November 15, 1966, two young couples from Point Pleasant-Roger and Linda Scarberry, Steve and Mary Mallette-told police they had seen a large black creature whose eyes "glowed red", standing at the side of the road near "the TNT area", the site of a former munitions plant from World War II.

statement.en: On November 15, 1966, two young couples from Point Pleasant, Roger and Linda Scarberry and Steve and Mary Mallette, told police they had seen a large black creature whose eyes "glowed red" at the side of the road near "the TNT area", the site of a former World War II munitions plant.

claims.quote: Linda Scarberry described it as a "slender, muscular man" about seven feet (2.1 m) tall with white wings. However, she was unable to discern its face due to the hypnotic effect of its eyes.

statement.id: Linda Scarberry menggambarkannya sebagai "lelaki langsing berotot" setinggi sekitar tujuh kaki dengan sayap putih, tetapi ia tidak dapat melihat wajahnya karena efek hipnotis dari matanya.
statement.en: Linda Scarberry described it as a "slender, muscular man" about seven feet tall with white wings, but she could not make out its face because of the hypnotic effect of its eyes.

claims.quote: Distressed, the witnesses claimed they sped away at 100 miles per hour (160 km/h), reporting that the creature took flight and kept pace with their car, making a screeching sound during the pursuit.

statement.id: Para saksi mengaku melaju kabur dengan kecepatan 100 mil per jam, dan melaporkan bahwa makhluk itu terbang dan mengimbangi mobil mereka sambil mengeluarkan suara melengking selama pengejaran.
statement.en: The witnesses claimed they sped away at 100 miles per hour, reporting that the creature took flight and kept pace with their car, making a screeching sound during the pursuit.

statement.en: Newell Partridge said that when he aimed a flashlight at a creature in a nearby field, its eyes glowed "like bicycle reflectors".

statement.en: The source of the legend is believed to have originated from sightings of out-of-migration sandhill cranes or herons, or possibly the misidentification of barred owls.

statement.en: Nickell attributes the Mothman stories to misidentifications of barred owls, suggesting the "glowing eyes" were actually eyeshine, a phenomenon common in many animals.

statement.en: Brunvand found elements in common between many Mothman reports and much older folktales, suggesting that something real may have triggered the scares and become interwoven with existing folklore.

long_description.id: Naga Biru-Hijau (青龍, Qīnglóng) adalah salah satu Dewa Naga, yaitu tunggangan atau kekuatan bumi bagi para dewa tertinggi di lima penjuru (五方上帝). Ia juga salah satu dari Empat Lambang rasi bintang Tiongkok, dan mewakili timur serta musim semi. Naga ini kadang disebut Naga Hijau atau Naga Biru, dan dikenal sebagai Seiryū dalam bahasa Jepang, Cheongryong dalam bahasa Korea, dan Thanh Long dalam bahasa Vietnam.
long_description.en: The Azure Dragon (青龍, Qīnglóng) is counted among the Dragon Gods, who serve as the mounts or earthly forces of the supreme deities of the five regions (五方上帝). Alongside three other creatures it makes up the Four Symbols of the Chinese constellations, and it stands for the east and for spring. The dragon is sometimes called the Green Dragon or the Blue Dragon, and is known as Seiryū in Japan, Cheongryong in Korea and Thanh Long in Vietnam.

long_description.id: Dalam wilayah rasinya terdapat tujuh "mansion" astrologis, yaitu posisi Bulan. Naga Biru-Hijau tampil sebagai dewa pintu di kuil Tao, dan teks Liji menempatkannya di sisi kiri dalam susunan arak-arakan bersama Xuanwu di belakang dan Harimau Putih di kanan. De Visser, mengutip De Groot, menulis bahwa warna biru dipilih karena merupakan warna timur, asal hujan, dan bahwa penjuru ini diwakili Naga Biru-Hijau, naga yang tertinggi dalam peringkat. Ia juga mencatat bahwa naga ini adalah lambang musim semi dan bahwa dua naga biru-hijau turun pada malam kelahiran Konfusius.
long_description.en: Its constellation region holds seven astrological "mansions", meaning positions of the Moon. The Azure Dragon shows up as a door god in Taoist temples, and the Liji text puts it on the left of a marching order, with Xuanwu at the back and the White Tiger on the right. De Visser, following De Groot, writes that blue is chosen because it is the colour of the east, where rain comes from, and that this quarter is represented by the Azure Dragon, the highest-ranking of all dragons. He also notes that it is the symbol of Spring and that two azure dragons came down on the night Confucius was born.

long_description.id: Di Jepang, Naga Biru-Hijau adalah salah satu dari empat roh penjaga kota dan dipercaya melindungi sisi timur Kyoto. Di Korea, lukisan makam Goguryeo di Uhyon-ni, provinsi South Pyongan, menampilkan Naga Biru-Hijau dan makhluk lain dari empat lambang. Naga ini dikaitkan dengan Raja Naga Laut Timur Ao Guang, yang dalam sastra Buddha adalah Raja Naga Sagara. De Visser menambahkan bahwa kemunculan naga kuning atau biru-hijau hampir selalu dianggap pertanda yang sangat baik.
long_description.en: In Japan the Azure Dragon is one of a city's four guardian spirits and is thought to watch over the east of Kyoto. In Korea, Goguryeo tomb paintings at Uhyon-ni in South Pyongan province show the Azure Dragon with the other creatures of the four symbols. The dragon is linked with Ao Guang, Dragon King of the East Sea, who appears in Buddhist literature as the Dragon King Sagara. De Visser adds that sightings of yellow or azure dragons were nearly always taken as a very good omen.

long_description.id: Kamus Kangxi, yang mengutip kamus-kamus yang lebih tua, menggambarkan lin sebagai makhluk berbadan 麕, berekor sapi, berdahi serigala, dan berkuku kuda, serta menyebutnya 仁獸, "binatang berbudi". Menurut Da Dai Liji, lin adalah pemimpin dari tiga ratus enam puluh jenis makhluk berbulu. Qi disebut jantan dan lin betina; Shuowen memberi qi satu tanduk, sedangkan Guo Pu menyatakan qi tidak bertanduk. Liji bab Liyun menempatkan lin di antara empat makhluk gaib (四靈) bersama burung feng, kura-kura, dan naga.
long_description.en: The Kangxi Dictionary, quoting older dictionaries, describes the lin as having a 麕 body, an ox tail, a wolf forehead and horse hooves, and calls it a 仁獸, a "benevolent beast". The Da Dai Liji calls the lin the chief of the three hundred and sixty furred creatures. The qi is called the male and the lin the female; the Shuowen gives the qi one horn, while Guo Pu says it has none. The Liji chapter Liyun places the lin among the four spirits (四靈) together with the feng bird, the tortoise and the dragon.

long_description.id: Syair dalam Kitab Nyanyian memuat penyebutan awal lin mitologis. Catatan Musim Semi dan Gugur menyebut penangkapan lin pada tahun keempat belas Adipati Ai dari Lu, dan Zuo Zhuan menceritakan bahwa Zhongni memeriksa hewan itu lalu berkata bahwa itu lin. Shuowen Jiezi membedakan qi sebagai jantan dan lin sebagai betina. Pada zaman Ming, citra qilin dihubungkan dengan jerapah yang dibawa setelah pelayaran Zheng He.
long_description.en: A poem in the Classic of Poetry provides an early mention of the mythical lin. The Spring and Autumn Annals record a lin's capture in Duke Ai of Lu's fourteenth year, and the Zuo Zhuan tells how Zhongni examined the animal and said it was a lin. The Shuowen Jiezi assigns qi to the male and lin to the female. During the Ming period, qilin imagery was associated with giraffes brought following Zheng He's voyages.

statement.en: The Kangxi Dictionary quotes the Yupian (玉篇) that the lin is a 仁獸 ("benevolent beast"), then cites the Zhounan poem "Lin zhi zhi" (麟之趾) of the Shi (詩) and the Zhuan (傳) commentary that the lin is trustworthy and responds to ritual propriety.

statement.en: The Liji chapter Liyun (禮運) asks what the 四靈 ("four spirits") are and answers: the lin (麟), the feng bird (鳳), the tortoise (龜) and the dragon (龍). The quotation continues that when the dragon is kept as a domestic animal (以爲畜), 魚鮪不淰.

short_description.id: Makara adalah makhluk laut legendaris dalam mitologi Hindu.
short_description.en: Makara is a legendary sea creature in Hindu mythology.

long_description.id: Makara adalah makhluk laut legendaris dalam mitologi Hindu; dalam astrologi Hindu, Makara setara dengan zodiak Capricorn. Ia menjadi tunggangan Ganga, Narmada, dan Varuna.
long_description.en: In Hindu mythology the makara is a legendary creature of the sea, and in Hindu astrology it corresponds to the Zodiac sign Capricorn. It serves as the mount of Ganga, Narmada, and Varuna.

long_description.id: Makara dianggap penjaga gerbang dan ambang kuil serta ruang takhta. Kata Sanskerta makara berarti hewan laut atau buaya. Bentuk umumnya menggabungkan bagian depan hewan darat dengan bagian belakang hewan air. Dalam karya Sinhala, makara menggabungkan bagian beberapa hewan, seperti belalai gajah dan rahang buaya.
long_description.en: Makaras are regarded as guardians of gateways and thresholds of temples and throne rooms. The Sanskrit word makara means sea animal or crocodile. Its common form combines a terrestrial animal's front with an aquatic animal's rear. In Sinhalese artwork a makara combines parts of several animals such as elephant trunk and crocodile jaws.

long_description.id: Makara adalah makhluk yang paling sering muncul dalam ikonografi kuil Hindu dan Buddha, dan juga kerap tampil sebagai gargoyle atau pancuran pada mata air alami. Anting berbentuk makara yang disebut Makarakundala kadang dikenakan dewa-dewi Hindu, misalnya Shiva, Vishnu, Surya, dan Chandi. Makara juga menjadi lambang dewa cinta Kamadeva. Pada masa Weda, Varuna menunggang makara yang disebut "kendaraan monster air".
long_description.en: No creature recurs more often in Hindu and Buddhist temple imagery, and the makara also often appears as a gargoyle or as a spout fixed to a natural spring. Hindu deities such as Shiva, Vishnu, Surya, and Chandi sometimes wear earrings in makara form, known as Makarakundalas. Makara is also the insignia of the love god Kamadeva. In Vedic times Varuna rode on a makara, which was called "the water monster vehicle".

long_description.id: Menurut Ganapati Sthapati, arsitek kuil Hindu, makara bertubuh ikan, berbelalai gajah, berkaki singa, bermata kera, bertelinga babi, dan berekor merak. Beberapa ilmuwan Jerman berpendapat makara didasarkan pada dugong, dan lumba-lumba sungai Asia Selatan mungkin juga menyumbang pada citranya. Di dunia modern, wujudnya selalu dikaitkan dengan buaya rawa atau biawak air.
long_description.en: The Hindu temple architect Ganapati Sthapati describes the makara as a mythical animal combining a fish's body with an elephant's trunk, a lion's feet, a monkey's eyes, a pig's ears and a peacock's tail. Several German scientists argued that makara is based on the dugong, and the South Asian river dolphin may also have contributed to its image. Today its form is consistently linked with the marsh crocodile or water monitor.

short_description.id: Mokele-mbembe adalah makhluk penghuni air yang dipercaya hidup di Lembah Sungai Kongo. Sumber menggambarkannya sebagai makhluk reptil, roh, atau mirip sauropoda, dan ilmuwan meragukan keberadaannya.
short_description.en: The mokele-mbembe is a water-dwelling being believed to live in the Congo River Basin. Sources describe it as a reptilian creature, a spirit, or a sauropod-like animal, and scientists doubt it exists.

long_description.id: Dalam beberapa mitologi Bantu, mokele-mbembe dikenal sebagai kriptid mitos penghuni air di Lembah Sungai Kongo. Artikel kedua menyebut nama itu berarti "sesuatu yang menahan aliran sungai" dalam bahasa Lingala. Ia digambarkan beragam sebagai makhluk reptil, roh, atau anggota garis keturunan sauropoda yang punah.
long_description.en: In several Bantu mythologies the mokele-mbembe is known as a mythical water-dwelling cryptid of the Congo River Basin. The second article says the name means "something that holds back the flow of rivers" in Lingala. Accounts differ on its nature: some treat it as a reptile, others as a spirit, and still others as a surviving sauropod.

long_description.id: Menurut tradisi rakyat, ia dikenal sebagai pemakan tanaman sebesar gajah atau kuda nil, tinggal di sungai dan rawa di sekitarnya. Beberapa legenda menyebut leher panjang, ekor, dan kepala kecil dengan warna cokelat keabu-abuan. Masyarakat desa Boha lebih menganggapnya makhluk tak berwujud daripada makhluk hidup.
long_description.en: In folk tradition it is known as a plant-eater as large as an elephant or hippopotamus, living in the river and the swamps around it. Some legends mention a long neck, a tail and a small head in grey-brown colour. The people of the village of Boha regard it more as an incorporeal being than as a living animal.

long_description.id: Laporan tertulis pertama yang disebut artikel pertama berasal dari Kapten Jerman Ludwig Freiherr von Stein zu Lausnitz, yang pada 1913 ditugaskan menyurvei koloni Jerman di wilayah yang kini bernama Kamerun. Menurut laporan yang dikutip, hewan itu berukuran sebesar gajah atau setidaknya kuda nil, tinggal di gua tepi sungai pada tikungan tajam, memakan tumbuhan, dan menyerang perahu yang mendekat.
long_description.en: The first written report named in the first article comes from German Captain Ludwig Freiherr von Stein zu Lausnitz, who in 1913 was ordered to survey German colonies in what is now Cameroon. According to the quoted report, the animal is about the size of an elephant or at least a hippopotamus, lives in river-bank caves at sharp bends, feeds on plants, and attacks canoes that come near.

long_description.id: Sebagian besar pakar arus utama meyakini bahwa kisah itu kemungkinan terinspirasi badak hitam, dan sebagian besar ilmuwan dan sejarawan meragukan keberadaannya karena minimnya bukti fisik serta kesaksian yang bertentangan. Sebuah wawancara dengan orang Biaka mencatat bahwa mereka mengenalinya sebagai badak pada gambar buku panduan satwa.
long_description.en: Most mainstream experts believe the stories were probably inspired by the black rhinoceros, and most scientists and historians doubt its existence because of the lack of physical evidence and conflicting witnesses. An interview with the Biaka people recorded that they identified it as a rhinoceros in an illustrated wildlife manual.

short_description.en: Black Tortoise, or Xuanwu, is a Chinese constellation symbol showing a turtle intertwined with a snake.

long_description.id: Black Tortoise atau Black Turtle-Snake (玄武, Xuánwǔ) adalah salah satu dari empat simbol rasi bintang Tiongkok. Biasanya digambarkan sebagai kura-kura yang berlilit dengan seekor ular. Ia mewakili utara sehingga kadang disebut prajurit hitam dari utara, dan mewakili musim dingin karena kura-kura dan ular berhibernasi pada musim dingin. Menurut Xu Shen, aksara wu (武) berarti "kesatria" dalam dialek Jianghuai.
long_description.en: The Black Turtle-Snake, or Black Tortoise (玄武, Xuánwǔ), is among the four symbols of the Chinese constellations and is normally drawn as a tortoise or turtle coiled together with a snake. It stands for the north, which is why it is at times named the black warrior of the north, and for winter, since tortoises and snakes hibernate in the cold season. Xu Shen explained the character wu (武) as meaning "knight" in the Jianghuai dialect.

long_description.id: Teks Liji menempatkan Xuanwu di belakang dalam susunan arak-arakan, dengan Naga Biru-Hijau di kiri dan Harimau Putih di kanan. Dalam syair Yuan You (Chu Ci), tokoh yang bepergian memanggil Xuanwu untuk mengikutinya.
long_description.en: The Liji text puts Xuanwu at the rear of a marching order, with the Azure Dragon on the left and the White Tiger on the right. In the poem Yuan You (Chu Ci), the traveller calls Xuanwu to follow him.

long_description.id: Di Tiongkok kuno, kura-kura dan ular dianggap makhluk spiritual yang melambangkan umur panjang. Dalam novel klasik Journey to the West, Xuanwu adalah raja utara dengan dua jenderal, Jenderal Kura-kura dan Jenderal Ular. Di Jepang, xuanwu dilafalkan Genbu; ia dikatakan melindungi sisi utara Kyoto sebagai satu dari empat roh penjaga kota, dan diwakili oleh Kuil Kenkun di puncak Gunung Funaoka.
long_description.en: In ancient China the tortoise and the serpent were regarded as spiritual creatures standing for long life. In the classic novel Journey to the West, Xuanwu is a king of the north served by two generals, a Tortoise General and a Snake General. In Japan the name is read Genbu; he is said to guard the north of Kyoto as one of the city's four guardian spirits and is represented by the Kenkun Shrine on top of Mount Funaoka.

short_description.id: Inti adalah dewa matahari Inca kuno yang dimuliakan sebagai pelindung negara Inca. Ia umumnya dianggap dewa yang murah hati, meski dapat murka.
short_description.en: Inti is the ancient Inca sun god, revered as the national patron of the Inca state. He was generally considered benevolent, although he could be angered.

long_description.id: Inti adalah dewa matahari Inca kuno dan dimuliakan sebagai pelindung negara Inca. Sebagian besar orang menganggapnya dewa matahari, tetapi ia lebih tepat dipandang sebagai gugusan aspek surya, karena bangsa Inca membagi identitasnya menurut tahap-tahap matahari, menjadi tiga subkompleks: ayah, putra, dan saudara. Ia dianggap mahakuasa sekaligus murah hati, namun dapat menunjukkan murkanya lewat gerhana matahari.
long_description.en: Inti is the ancient Inca sun god, held up as patron of the Inca state. Most people regard him as the sun god, yet he is better seen as a cluster of solar aspects, since the Inca split his identity along the stages of the sun into three sub-complexes: father, son and brother. He was thought all-powerful and generous, yet able to show anger through solar eclipses.

long_description.id: Menurut kepercayaan yang paling umum, Inti lahir dari Viracocha; sumber lain menyebut Viracocha menciptakan matahari dari sebuah pulau di Danau Titicaca. Inti juga disebut saudara dan, menurut sumber lain, suami Quilla, dewi bulan. Penguasa Inca menganggap diri keturunan langsungnya dan penguasa Inca dipandang sebagai perwakilan hidupnya, sedangkan Manco Capac dipercaya diajari atau malah putranya.
long_description.en: The most common belief was that Inti was born of Viracocha, though another source says Viracocha made the sun from an island on Lake Titicaca. Inti is also called the brother of Quilla, goddess of the moon, and by another source her husband. Inca rulers saw themselves as his direct descendants and the Inca ruler was regarded as his living representative, while Manco Capac was believed to have been taught by him or even to be his son.

long_description.id: Kuil Coricancha di Cuzco dipersembahkan kepada Inti, dan ia dipuja terutama pada festival Inti Raymi. Pachacuti sering dikaitkan dengan asal dan perluasan Kultus Matahari Inca. Salah satu persembahan yang paling umum adalah llama putih. Dalam seni, ia jarang digambarkan; bila ada, wujudnya berupa patung emas, cakram matahari, atau topeng emas, dan salah satu patung menampilkannya sebagai anak kecil duduk bernama Punchao.
long_description.en: The Coricancha temple at Cuzco was dedicated to Inti, and he was worshipped above all at the Inti Raymi festival. Pachacuti is often linked with the origin and spread of the Inca Sun Cult. White llamas were among the commonest offerings. In art he was seldom portrayed; when he was, the form was a gold statue, a sun disk or a golden mask, and one statue showed him as a small seated boy called Punchao.

cultural_context.id: Matahari penting bagi bangsa Inca, terutama penduduk dataran tinggi, karena diperlukan bagi tanaman seperti jagung; panasnya juga dianggap menyebabkan hujan.

claims.quote: Although most consider Inti the sun god, he is more appropriately viewed as a cluster of solar aspects, since the Inca divided his identity according to the stages of the sun.

statement.id: Inti dipandang sebagai dewa matahari sekaligus klaster aspek surya.
statement.en: Although most consider Inti the sun god, he is viewed as a cluster of solar aspects.

claims.quote: The most common belief was that Inti was born of Viracocha, who had many titles, chief among them being the God of Creation.

statement.id: Keyakinan umum menyatakan bahwa Inti dilahirkan oleh Viracocha.
statement.en: The most common belief was that Inti was born of Viracocha.

claims.quote: Worshiped as a patron deity of the Inca Empire, Pachacuti is often linked to the origin and expansion of the Inca Sun Cult.

statement.id: Dipuja sebagai dewa pelindung kekaisaran, pemujaannya dikaitkan dengan Pachacuti.
statement.en: Worshiped as a patron deity of the Inca Empire, Pachacuti is linked to his cult.

claims.quote: Inti and his sister, Mama Quilla (also spelled Mama Killa), the Moon goddess were generally considered benevolent deities.

statement.id: Inti dan saudarinya Mama Quilla umumnya dianggap sebagai dewa yang murah hati.
statement.en: Inti and his sister, Mama Quilla, were generally considered benevolent deities.

claims.quote: Inti was the Inca god of the sun and considered all-powerful but he was also a benevolent god and capable of great generosity.

statement.id: Inti adalah dewa matahari Inca yang dianggap mahakuasa, tetapi juga dewa yang murah hati dan mampu bersikap sangat dermawan.
statement.en: Inti was the Inca god of the sun, considered all-powerful, but also a benevolent god capable of great generosity.

claims.quote: However, Inti could be angered and he would demonstrate his displeasure through solar eclipses which necessitated sacrifices to win back the god's good favour.

statement.id: Inti dapat murka dan menunjukkan ketidaksenangannya lewat gerhana matahari, yang menuntut persembahan untuk memulihkan kembali kemurahan sang dewa.
statement.en: Inti could be angered and showed his displeasure through solar eclipses, which called for sacrifices to win back the god's good favour.

claims.quote: Inca rulers considered themselves direct descendants of Inti, the patron of empire and military conquest.

statement.id: Para penguasa Inca menganggap diri keturunan langsung Inti, pelindung kekaisaran dan penaklukan militer.
statement.en: Inca rulers considered themselves direct descendants of Inti, the patron of empire and military conquest.

claims.quote: Inti was the sun, which in Inca mythology was created by the supreme Inca deity Viracocha from an island on Lake Titicaca.

statement.id: Inti adalah matahari, yang dalam mitologi Inca diciptakan oleh dewa tertinggi Inca, Viracocha, dari sebuah pulau di Danau Titicaca.
statement.en: Inti was the sun, which in Inca mythology was created by the supreme Inca deity Viracocha from an island on Lake Titicaca.

claims.quote: Although Viracocha was higher in status, he usually remained in the background of worldly affairs and allowed intermediaries such as Inti to actually govern the world.

statement.id: Meski Viracocha berkedudukan lebih tinggi, ia biasanya tinggal di latar belakang urusan duniawi dan membiarkan perantara seperti Inti benar-benar memerintah dunia.
statement.en: Although Viracocha was higher in status, he usually remained in the background of worldly affairs and let intermediaries such as Inti actually govern the world.

claims.quote: Inti was married to the goddess of the moon Quilla.

statement.id: Inti menikah dengan Quilla, dewi bulan.
statement.en: Inti was married to the goddess of the moon Quilla.

claims.quote: Manco Capac (previously called Ayar Manco) was believed either to have been instructed by Inti or actually been his son

statement.id: Manco Capac (sebelumnya bernama Ayar Manco) dipercaya diajari oleh Inti atau malah putranya.
statement.en: Manco Capac (previously called Ayar Manco) was believed either to have been instructed by Inti or to have actually been his son.

claims.quote: it was not until Wiraqocha Inca (c. 1425 CE) or the 9th Inca ruler Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui (1438-1471 CE) that the cult of Inti really became established in the cultural practices of the Inca.

statement.id: Kultus Inti baru benar-benar mapan dalam praktik budaya Inca pada masa Wiraqocha Inca (sekitar 1425 M) atau penguasa Inca ke-9, Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui (1438-1471 M).
statement.en: The cult of Inti only became really established in Inca cultural practices under Wiraqocha Inca (c. 1425 CE) or the 9th Inca ruler Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui (1438-1471 CE).

claims.quote: The Coricancha temple ('House of the Sun') and Sacsahuaman sacred precinct at the Inca capital of Cuzco were dedicated to Inti.

statement.id: Kuil Coricancha ('Rumah Matahari') dan kawasan suci Sacsahuaman di ibu kota Inca, Cuzco, dipersembahkan kepada Inti.
statement.en: The Coricancha temple ('House of the Sun') and the Sacsahuaman sacred precinct at the Inca capital Cuzco were dedicated to Inti.

claims.quote: Perhaps the most famous example is at Machu Picchu where a typical intihuatana or 'hitching post of the sun' situated at the highest point of the sacred precinct was used during the solstices to symbolically connect the sun to the earth using a special cord.

statement.id: Contoh paling terkenal ada di Machu Picchu, tempat intihuatana atau 'tiang penambat matahari' di titik tertinggi kawasan suci dipakai pada titik balik matahari untuk menghubungkan matahari dengan bumi secara simbolis memakai tali khusus.
statement.en: Perhaps the most famous example is at Machu Picchu, where an intihuatana or 'hitching post of the sun' at the highest point of the sacred precinct was used during the solstices to connect the sun symbolically to the earth with a special cord.

claims.quote: Inti was especially worshipped during the festival of Inti Raymi held during the winter solstice in June and run over several days. One of the most common sacrifices to Inti was of white llamas

statement.id: Inti terutama dipuja pada festival Inti Raymi yang digelar pada titik balik matahari musim dingin bulan Juni selama beberapa hari; salah satu persembahan paling umum adalah llama putih.
statement.en: Inti was especially worshipped during the Inti Raymi festival, held at the winter solstice in June over several days; one of the most common sacrifices was white llamas.

claims.quote: Inti was not often represented in Inca art but when he was it was usually as a gold statue, a sun disk or a golden mask. Gold was particularly associated with the god as it was believed that the precious metal was the sweat of the sun.

statement.id: Inti jarang digambarkan dalam seni Inca, dan bila digambarkan biasanya sebagai patung emas, cakram matahari, atau topeng emas; emas dikaitkan dengan sang dewa karena dipercaya sebagai keringat matahari.
statement.en: Inti was not often represented in Inca art, and when he was it was usually as a gold statue, a sun disk or a golden mask; gold was associated with the god because it was believed to be the sweat of the sun.

claims.quote: The statue represented Inti as a small seated boy, called Punchao (Day or Midday Sun).

statement.id: Patung itu menggambarkan Inti sebagai anak kecil yang duduk, bernama Punchao (Matahari Siang atau Tengah Hari).
statement.en: The statue represented Inti as a small seated boy, called Punchao (Day or Midday Sun).

claims.quote: One curious story is when an eagle was attacked by buzzards and fell from the skies during a ceremony in honour of Inti held in c. 1526 CE which was thought to foretell the collapse of the Inca empire.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, seekor elang diserang burung nasar kecil dan jatuh dari langit saat upacara untuk Inti sekitar 1526 M, yang dianggap meramalkan runtuhnya Kekaisaran Inca.
statement.en: In one story an eagle was attacked by buzzards and fell from the skies during a ceremony in honour of Inti in c. 1526 CE, which was thought to foretell the collapse of the Inca empire.

claims.quote: The god's worshippers and the vast majority of the art made in his name have long since disappeared but Inti lives on in several present day South American cultures.

statement.id: Para pemuja sang dewa dan sebagian besar seni yang dibuat atas namanya telah lama lenyap, tetapi Inti masih hidup dalam beberapa budaya Amerika Selatan masa kini.
statement.en: The god's worshippers and most of the art made in his name have long since disappeared, but Inti lives on in several present-day South American cultures.

claims.quote: The festival of Inti Raymi has been revived as a great yearly festival in Cuzco, several national flags bear an image of him in the form of a flaming sun

statement.id: Festival Inti Raymi dihidupkan kembali sebagai festival tahunan besar di Cuzco, dan beberapa bendera nasional memuat gambarnya berupa matahari yang menyala.
statement.en: The Inti Raymi festival has been revived as a great yearly festival in Cuzco, and several national flags bear an image of him as a flaming sun.

claims.quote: Other important temples were at Pisac (north-east of Cuzco), Ingapirca (in modern Ecuador), and on the Island of the Sun on Lake Titicaca which Inca rulers visited once a year in pilgrimage.

statement.id: Kuil penting lain berada di Pisac, Ingapirca (di Ekuador masa kini), dan di Pulau Matahari di Danau Titicaca, yang dikunjungi para penguasa Inca setahun sekali dalam ziarah.
statement.en: Other important temples were at Pisac, Ingapirca (in modern Ecuador) and on the Island of the Sun on Lake Titicaca, which Inca rulers visited once a year in pilgrimage.

claims.quote: Inti (Quechua: inti, lit. 'sun' ) is the ancient Inca sun god. He is revered as the national patron of the Inca state.

statement.id: Inti (Quechua: inti, secara harfiah 'matahari') adalah dewa matahari Inca kuno, dimuliakan sebagai pelindung nasional negara Inca.
statement.en: Inti (Quechua: inti, literally 'sun') is the ancient Inca sun god, revered as the national patron of the Inca state.

claims.quote: The word inti is not of Quechua origin but a loanword from Puquina.

statement.id: Kata inti bukan berasal dari bahasa Quechua, melainkan kata serapan dari bahasa Puquina.
statement.en: The word inti is not of Quechua origin but a loanword from Puquina.

claims.quote: According to myth, Inti taught Manco Cápac and his daughter Mama Ocllo the arts of civilization.

statement.id: Menurut mitos, Inti mengajarkan seni peradaban kepada Manco Cápac dan putrinya, Mama Ocllo.
statement.en: According to myth, Inti taught Manco Cápac and his daughter Mama Ocllo the arts of civilization.

claims.quote: The sun was also important to the Incas, particularly the people of the highlands, because it was necessary for the production of crops like maize and other grains. The sun's heat was also thought to cause rain.

statement.id: Matahari penting bagi bangsa Inca, terutama penduduk dataran tinggi, karena diperlukan untuk menghasilkan jagung dan biji-bijian lain; panas matahari juga dianggap menyebabkan hujan.
statement.en: The sun was important to the Incas, particularly highland people, because it was necessary for producing maize and other grains; the sun's heat was also thought to cause rain.

claims.quote: Inti's identity is also divided into three primary subcomplexes, which are the father, son, and brother.

statement.id: Identitas Inti juga dibagi menjadi tiga subkompleks utama, yaitu ayah, putra, dan saudara.
statement.en: Inti's identity is also divided into three primary subcomplexes: the father, the son and the brother.

claims.quote: The first of these is Apu Inti ("supreme Inti"). He represents the father and is sometimes known as "The Lord Sun". The second is Churi Inti, or "Son Inti", who represents the son of Inti and is often known as "Daylight". The third and final division of Inti is Inti Wawqi ("Sun brother", or "Inti brother", also spelled Inti-Guauqui, Inti-Huaoqui).

statement.id: Ketiganya adalah Apu Inti ("Inti tertinggi"), Churi Inti ("Inti putra", sering disebut "Cahaya Siang"), dan Inti Wawqi ("saudara matahari").
statement.en: The three are Apu Inti ("supreme Inti"), Churi Inti ("Son Inti", often known as "Daylight") and Inti Wawqi ("Sun brother").

claims.quote: Some sources identify the central figure of the Gateway of the Sun as Inti and others as Viracocha

statement.id: Sebagian sumber mengidentifikasi tokoh utama pada Gerbang Matahari sebagai Inti dan sebagian lain sebagai Viracocha.
statement.en: Some sources identify the central figure of the Gateway of the Sun as Inti and others as Viracocha.

claims.quote: The Sun is also depicted on the coat of arms of Bolivia and coat of arms of Ecuador, the Flag of the Hispanic people, as well as the historical flag of Peru. statement.en: The Sun is also depicted on the coats of arms of Bolivia and Ecuador and the historical flag of Peru; all these countries (including northern Chile and parts of Argentina) were historically part of the Inca Empire.

short_description.id: Pachamama atau Mama Pacha adalah dewa Andes yang mewakili ruang-waktu, dipuja bangsa-bangsa Andes sebagai dewi ibu yang menopang kehidupan dan kesuburan.
short_description.en: Pachamama, also called Mama Pacha, is an Andean deity who stands for space-time and is honoured by Andean peoples as a mother goddess sustaining life and fertility.

long_description.id: Pachamama atau Mama Pacha adalah dewa Andes yang mewakili ruang-waktu dan dipuja oleh bangsa-bangsa Andes. Dalam mitologi dan agama Inca, ia dipandang sebagai dewi ibu yang terkait kehidupan, kesuburan, dan alam, dan dianggap hadir di mana-mana serta berdaya cipta untuk menopang kehidupan. Empat prinsip kosmologis Quechua (Air, Bumi, Matahari, dan Bulan) menganggapnya asal utama, dan dari kesuburannya kosmos dikatakan lahir dan bumi disuburkan.
long_description.en: Pachamama, also called Mama Pacha, is an Andean deity who stands for space-time and is honoured by Andean peoples. Inca mythology and religion treat her as a mother goddess connected with life, fertility and nature, thought to be ever-present and able to create and sustain life. Four cosmological Quechua principles (Water, Earth, Sun and Moon) trace their origin to her, and the cosmos is said to be born from her fertility, with the earth made fertile.

long_description.id: Ia biasanya dewi yang penuh kasih dan murah hati, tetapi dapat menjadi mengerikan dan merusak ketika tersinggung. Pachamama umum dipuja dalam wujud duniawinya, Allpamama atau Mama Allpa; kuilnya berupa batu keramat atau batang pohon legendaris, dan ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan pembawa hasil panen kentang atau daun koka. Para imam mempersembahkan llama, marmut, dan pakaian mini yang dibakar kepadanya. Ia juga digambarkan sebagai dewi purba yang tidak membutuhkan kuil khusus.
long_description.en: She is normally loving and generous, yet can turn terrible and destructive when offended. Pachamama was commonly worshipped in her earthly form, Allpamama or Mama Allpa; her shrines were sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and she was pictured as a woman carrying potato or coca-leaf harvests. Priests offered llamas, guinea pigs and small burned garments to her. She is also described as an ancient goddess who needs no special temples.

long_description.id: Pemujaannya berlangsung lewat persembahan. Pemuka Andes bernama Rufino Turpo menceritakan keluarganya berkumpul pada awal Agustus untuk membuat "pembayaran" kepada Pachamama, yang seperti manusia perlu makan dan minum; sang Ibu dikatakan marah bila orang membayar tanpa hormat, dan persembahan dibakar sehingga asapnya membawa doa. Di beberapa daerah, orang menumpahkan sedikit chicha ke tanah setiap hari sebagai challa.
long_description.en: Her worship proceeds through offerings. An Andean writer, Rufino Turpo, recounts his family gathering at the start of August to make a "payment" to Pachamama, who like people needs to eat and drink; the Mother is said to be angered by payment made without respect, and the offering is burned so that the smoke carries prayers. In some regions people spill a little chicha on the ground daily as a challa.

long_description.id: Program Peru pada Festival Folklife 2015 memakai nama Pachamama, "Ibu Bumi" dalam bahasa Quechua dan Aymara. Menurut kajian, kronik Peru abad keenam belas dan ketujuh belas memuat rincian tentang kultus bumi pra-Hispanik dan kelangsungannya pada dekade awal kolonisasi. Melalui sinkretisme, Perawan Maria dikaitkan dengan Pachamama, dan pada abad ke-21 banyak masyarakat adat mendasarkan kepedulian lingkungan pada kepercayaan ini.
long_description.en: The Peru program of the 2015 Folklife Festival took its name from Pachamama, "Mother Earth" in Quechua and Aymara. Scholarship notes that Peruvian chronicles of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries record details of pre-Hispanic earth cults and their persistence in the early decades of colonization. Through syncretism the Virgin Mary was associated with Pachamama, and in the 21st century many Indigenous peoples ground environmental concerns in these beliefs.

cultural_context.id: Pada abad ke-21, banyak masyarakat adat di Amerika Selatan mendasarkan kepedulian lingkungan pada kepercayaan kepada Pachamama, dengan mengatakan bahwa mengambil terlalu banyak dari alam berarti mengambil terlalu banyak dari Pachamama.
cultural_context.en: In the 21st century, many Indigenous peoples of South America ground their environmental concerns in belief in Pachamama, holding that over-taking from nature means over-taking from Pachamama.

claims.quote: or Mama Pacha ... is the Andean deity representing space-time, revered by the peoples of the Andes.

statement.id: Pachamama atau Mama Pacha adalah dewa Andes yang mewakili ruang-waktu dan dipuja oleh bangsa-bangsa Andes.
statement.en: Pachamama or Mama Pacha is the Andean deity representing space-time, revered by the peoples of the Andes.

claims.quote: The four cosmological Quechua principles—Water, Earth, Sun, and Moon—claim Pachamama as their prime origin.

statement.id: Empat prinsip kosmologi Quechua—Air, Bumi, Matahari, dan Bulan—berasal dari Pachamama.
statement.en: The four cosmological Quechua principles claim Pachamama as their origin.

claims.quote: She is considered an omnipresent deity with creative power, capable of sustaining life in the cosmos.

statement.id: Ia dianggap dewa yang hadir di mana-mana dan memiliki daya cipta untuk menopang kehidupan di kosmos.
statement.en: She is considered an omnipresent deity with creative power, capable of sustaining life in the cosmos.

claims.quote: In Inca mythology and religion, she is a "mother goddess" type deity, representing the universal energy that connects everything, linked to space, time, the universe, totality, life, fertility, and nature.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi dan agama Inca, ia adalah dewa bertipe "dewi ibu" yang mewakili energi universal yang menghubungkan segalanya, terkait ruang, waktu, alam semesta, totalitas, kehidupan, kesuburan, dan alam.
statement.en: In Inca mythology and religion, she is a "mother goddess" type deity representing the universal energy that connects everything, linked to space, time, the universe, totality, life, fertility and nature.

claims.quote: She is attributed with the role of mother of the world, from whom the material and spiritual sustenance of human beings comes.

statement.id: Ia dianggap berperan sebagai ibu dunia, tempat asal sumber penghidupan material dan spiritual manusia.
statement.en: She is attributed with the role of mother of the world, from whom the material and spiritual sustenance of human beings comes.

claims.quote: In various myths, Pachamama is described as the wife of Pachacámac and mother of Mama Quilla (the goddess of the moon) and Inti (the god of the sun).

statement.id: Dalam berbagai mitos, Pachamama digambarkan sebagai istri Pachacámac dan ibu Mama Quilla (dewi bulan) dan Inti (dewa matahari).
statement.en: In various myths, Pachamama is described as the wife of Pachacámac and mother of Mama Quilla (the goddess of the moon) and Inti (the god of the sun).

claims.quote: Pachamama was commonly worshipped in her earthly manifestation or form called Allpamama or Mama Allpa (goddess of the earth), her shrines consisted of sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and artists depicted her as a woman bearing harvests of potatoes or coca leaves.

statement.id: Pachamama umum dipuja dalam wujud duniawinya yang disebut Allpamama atau Mama Allpa (dewi bumi); kuilnya berupa batu keramat atau batang pohon legendaris, dan seniman menggambarkannya sebagai perempuan pembawa hasil panen kentang atau daun koka.
statement.en: Pachamama was commonly worshipped in her earthly form called Allpamama or Mama Allpa (goddess of the earth); her shrines were sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and artists depicted her as a woman bearing harvests of potatoes or coca leaves.

claims.quote: Priests sacrifice offerings of llamas, cuy (guinea pigs), and elaborate, miniature, burned garments to her.

statement.id: Para imam mempersembahkan llama, cuy (marmut), dan pakaian mini yang rumit yang dibakar kepadanya.
statement.en: Priests sacrifice offerings of llamas, cuy (guinea pigs) and elaborate miniature burned garments to her.

claims.quote: She is normally a loving and generous goddess, but she can be terrible, cruel, and destructive when she is upset or feels hurt, capable of destroying men and everything above or within her.

statement.id: Ia biasanya dewi yang penuh kasih dan murah hati, tetapi bisa mengerikan, kejam, dan merusak ketika marah atau merasa terluka, mampu menghancurkan manusia dan segala yang ada di atas atau di dalamnya.
statement.en: She is normally a loving and generous goddess, but she can be terrible, cruel and destructive when upset or hurt, capable of destroying men and everything above or within her.

claims.quote: Pachamama is an ancient and primordial goddess who does not need temples or specific places of worship, although she likes springs, simply because she is everywhere and at all times.

statement.id: Pachamama adalah dewi purba dan primordial yang tidak membutuhkan kuil atau tempat ibadah khusus, meskipun ia menyukai mata air, karena ia ada di mana-mana dan sepanjang waktu.
statement.en: Pachamama is an ancient and primordial goddess who does not need temples or specific places of worship, although she likes springs, simply because she is everywhere and at all times.

claims.quote: The word Pachamama comes from the Quechua language and is composed of two terms: Pacha: a complex word meaning 'world, universe, space-time, totality, era, cosmos'.

statement.id: Kata Pachamama berasal dari bahasa Quechua dan terdiri atas dua unsur; yang pertama, pacha, adalah kata kompleks yang berarti 'dunia, alam semesta, ruang-waktu, totalitas, zaman, kosmos'.
statement.en: The word Pachamama comes from the Quechua language and has two parts; the first, pacha, is a complex word meaning 'world, universe, space-time, totality, era, cosmos'.

claims.quote: Mama: means mother, but also represents the feminine principle that generates and nourishes life.

statement.id: Unsur kedua, mama, berarti ibu, tetapi juga mewakili prinsip feminin yang melahirkan dan memelihara kehidupan.
statement.en: The second part, mama, means mother, but also represents the feminine principle that generates and nourishes life.

claims.quote: Pachamama plays the role of cosmic mother; from Pachamama's fertility, the cosmos is born, the earth is fertilized, and then it flourishes.

statement.id: Pachamama berperan sebagai ibu kosmik; dari kesuburannya kosmos lahir, bumi disuburkan, dan kemudian berkembang.
statement.en: Pachamama plays the role of cosmic mother; from her fertility the cosmos is born, the earth is fertilized, and it then flourishes.

claims.quote: Allpamama is often hungry, and if she is not nourished with offerings or if she is offended, she can cause a cosmic imbalance that breaks the universal harmony affecting all worlds

statement.id: Allpamama sering lapar, dan bila tidak diberi persembahan atau tersinggung, ia dapat menimbulkan ketidakseimbangan kosmik yang merusak keharmonisan semesta yang memengaruhi semua dunia.
statement.en: Allpamama is often hungry, and if she is not nourished with offerings or is offended, she can cause a cosmic imbalance that breaks the universal harmony affecting all worlds.

claims.quote: Pachamama and her sun-husband, Inti, are worshipped as benevolent deities in the area known as Tawantinsuyu. Tawantinsuyu is the name of the former Inca Empire, and the region stretches through the Andean mountains in present-day Bolivia, Ecuador, Chile, Peru, Colombia and northern Argentina.

statement.id: Pachamama dan suaminya, sang matahari Inti, dipuja sebagai dewa-dewi yang murah hati di wilayah yang dikenal sebagai Tawantinsuyu, bekas Kekaisaran Inca yang membentang melintasi pegunungan Andes di Bolivia, Ekuador, Chile, Peru, Kolombia, dan Argentina utara masa kini.
statement.en: Pachamama and her sun-husband Inti are worshipped as benevolent deities in the area known as Tawantinsuyu, the former Inca Empire, stretching through the Andean mountains in present-day Bolivia, Ecuador, Chile, Peru, Colombia and northern Argentina.

claims.quote: In some regions, people perform a special kind of libation known as a challa on a daily basis. They spill a small amount of chicha on the floor, for the goddess, and then drink the rest.

statement.id: Di beberapa daerah, orang melakukan persembahan cairan khusus bernama challa setiap hari: mereka menumpahkan sedikit chicha ke tanah untuk sang dewi, lalu meminum sisanya.
statement.en: In some regions people perform a special libation known as a challa on a daily basis: they spill a little chicha on the floor for the goddess and then drink the rest.

claims.quote: The central ritual to Pachamama is the Challa or Pago (payment). It is carried out during all of August, and in many places also on the first Friday of each month.

statement.id: Ritual utama bagi Pachamama adalah Challa atau Pago (pembayaran), yang dilakukan sepanjang bulan Agustus dan di banyak tempat juga pada Jumat pertama setiap bulan.
statement.en: The central ritual to Pachamama is the Challa or Pago (payment), carried out during all of August and in many places also on the first Friday of each month.

claims.quote: Through religious syncretism, the figure of the Virgin Mary was associated with that of Pachamama for many Indigenous peoples.

statement.id: Melalui sinkretisme agama, sosok Perawan Maria dikaitkan dengan Pachamama oleh banyak masyarakat adat.
statement.en: Through religious syncretism, the figure of the Virgin Mary was associated with that of Pachamama for many Indigenous peoples.

claims.quote: In the 21st century, many Indigenous peoples in South America base environmental concerns in these ancient beliefs, saying that problems arise when people take too much from nature because they are taking too much from Pachamama.

statement.id: Pada abad ke-21, banyak masyarakat adat di Amerika Selatan mendasarkan kepedulian lingkungan pada kepercayaan kuno ini, dengan mengatakan bahwa masalah muncul ketika manusia mengambil terlalu banyak dari alam karena berarti mengambil terlalu banyak dari Pachamama.
statement.en: In the 21st century, many Indigenous peoples in South America base environmental concerns on these ancient beliefs, saying that problems arise when people take too much from nature because they are taking too much from Pachamama.

claims.quote: Parents Viracocha Consort Pacha Kamaq, Inti Offspring Inti Mama Killa

statement.id: Kotak info Wikipedia mencantumkan Viracocha sebagai orang tua, Pacha Kamaq dan Inti sebagai pasangan, serta Inti dan Mama Killa sebagai keturunan Pachamama.
statement.en: The article infobox lists Viracocha as parent, Pacha Kamaq and Inti as consorts, and Inti and Mama Killa as offspring of Pachamama.

claims.quote: The Peru program at the 2015 Folklife Festival takes its name from the Pachamama, translating to "Mother Earth" in the native Quechua and Aymara languages

statement.id: Program Peru pada Festival Folklife 2015 memakai nama Pachamama, yang dalam bahasa asli Quechua dan Aymara berarti "Ibu Bumi".
statement.en: The Peru program at the 2015 Folklife Festival takes its name from Pachamama, which means "Mother Earth" in the native Quechua and Aymara languages.

claims.quote: In this story, Rufino Turpo (son of the late Nazario Turpo, guardian and Pacco ritual master of the sacred Ausangate Mountain) shares the life-sustaining role of Pachamama: mother of all living beings, the core of existence, the symbol of fertility.

statement.id: Rufino Turpo menguraikan peran Pachamama yang menopang kehidupan: ibu semua makhluk hidup, inti keberadaan, dan lambang kesuburan.
statement.en: Rufino Turpo describes the life-sustaining role of Pachamama: mother of all living beings, the core of existence, the symbol of fertility.

claims.quote: On the first day of Chajrayapuy (August), our family gathers to make a "payment" or offering to the Pachamama. Like us, she needs to eat and drink. Whenever we drink chicha, beer, or wine, we need to share it with her.

statement.id: Pada hari pertama Chajrayapuy (Agustus), keluarga berkumpul untuk membuat "pembayaran" atau persembahan kepada Pachamama; seperti manusia, ia perlu makan dan minum, dan setiap kali minum chicha, bir, atau anggur, minuman itu harus dibagikan kepadanya.
statement.en: On the first day of Chajrayapuy (August) the family gathers to make a "payment" or offering to Pachamama; like people, she needs to eat and drink, and whenever chicha, beer or wine is drunk it must be shared with her.

claims.quote: We offer all this for Pachamama to eat, and in return she provides for us and protects us. Finally, we burn the offering. Smoke rises, taking our prayers.

statement.id: Semua persembahan itu diberikan agar Pachamama makan, dan sebagai balasannya ia menyediakan kebutuhan dan melindungi; persembahan lalu dibakar dan asapnya membawa doa.
statement.en: All this is offered for Pachamama to eat, and in return she provides for the people and protects them; the offering is then burned and the smoke carries the prayers.

claims.quote: The Mother gets angry when you want to pay without respect, without knowing why.

statement.id: Sang Ibu marah bila orang membayar tanpa hormat dan tanpa tahu alasannya.
statement.en: The Mother gets angry when you want to pay without respect, without knowing why.

claims.quote: This article analyzes the cult to Andean Mother Earth known as Pachamama, starting from the references contained in those Peruvian chronicles of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries

statement.id: Artikel jurnal ini menganalisis kultus Ibu Bumi Andes yang dikenal sebagai Pachamama berdasarkan rujukan dalam kronik Peru abad keenam belas dan ketujuh belas.
statement.en: This journal article analyzes the cult of Andean Mother Earth known as Pachamama, starting from references in Peruvian chronicles of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.

claims.quote: We emphasize, in particular, the peculiarity of the details that they provide about terminology, representations, beliefs and rituals associated with telluric cults in the Prehispanic period, and their persistence throughout the first decades of colonization of the central Andes.

statement.id: Kronik-kronik itu memberi rincian khas tentang istilah, penggambaran, kepercayaan, dan ritual kultus bumi pada masa pra-Hispanik, serta kelangsungannya selama beberapa dekade pertama kolonisasi Andes tengah.
statement.en: The chronicles give distinctive details about terminology, representations, beliefs and rituals of the telluric cults of the Prehispanic period, and their persistence through the first decades of colonization of the central Andes.

user_policy.name: sangar
user_policy.intent: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
user_policy.subject: The being dominates the frame and is clearly the subject. Head, eyes and distinguishing traits are readable even at thumbnail size. Never a landscape without the being, never a human who could be a passer-by, never a farm animal at pasture.
user_policy.moment: Depict a moment, not a pose: hunting, emerging, striking, commanding, towering, descending, tearing through weather or ground. Gaze and posture confront or loom over the viewer. Standing still and facing the camera with a neutral expression is not acceptable.
user_policy.effects: Visible power is wanted and may be strong, but every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute, habitat or deed documented in the research claims of that being, and it must act physically on the world: ground cracking, water rearing, trees bending, lightning striking, flame consuming, fog pouring, bodies of victims turned to stone. No generic glowing envelope, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or luminous coloured mist. If the research documents no power, build menace from anatomy, scale, moment, light and setting instead, and record that in artistic_choices.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, eyes, limbs and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects and atmosphere add power; they never replace or invent anatomy. Fully opaque clothing where a humanlike form is clothed; no nudity, no explicit gore.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle; monumental or predatory scale with small environmental references when size is documented, otherwise dominance through tight framing and foreshortening. Strong silhouette, high contrast, cinematic low-key lighting from one dominant source (moon, fire, lightning, dying sun), rim light, dust, smoke, rain or spray. Tactile surfaces: wet scales, matted fur, cracked skin, rust, weathered cloth, stone.
user_policy.setting: The place its stories name: graveyard, swamp, sea cliff, battlefield, celestial palace, desert storm. Weather and time of day heighten threat or majesty. Palette is dark and warm with one strong accent, consistent with the collection; no pastel, no flat even daylight.
user_policy.respect: Living religions (Hindu, Buddhist, Shinto, Abrahamic and folk deities still worshipped) are majestic and overwhelming rather than monstrous: cosmic scale, divine radiance from documented attributes, the elements they rule in motion. Malevolent beings are menacing. Literary beings follow their source text, never a film, game, anime or comic design.
user_policy.aniconic: If the research documents no bodily form at all, either depict the documented manifestation as an active, overwhelming force (the sky itself splitting, a storm swallowing the steppe) with the choice recorded in artistic_choices, or decline the entry with status tidak-digambar.
